note: Complete wisdom units - grouped where thematic, standalone where couplets

units.text: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding; to receive instruction in wise dealing to give prudence to the simple that the wise man may hear to understand a proverb

My son If they say let's swallow them up alive like Sheol We'll find all valuable wealth. We'll fill our houses with spoil. You shall cast your lot among us. We'll all have one purse. My son for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood. For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives. So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

How long Turn at my reproof. Behold Because I have called but you have ignored all my counsel I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you; when calamity overtakes you like a storm Then will they call on me because they hated knowledge They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof. Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them. But whoever listens to me will dwell securely

My son So as to turn your ear to wisdom Yes If you seek her as silver then you will understand the fear of Yahweh For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding. He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity; that he may guard the paths of justice Then you will understand righteousness and justice For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul. Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you to deliver you from the way of evil who forsake the paths of uprightness who rejoice to do evil who are crooked in their ways To deliver you from the strange woman who forsakes the friend of her youth for her house leads down to death None who go to her return again that you may walk in the way of good men For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it. But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
My son for length of days Don't let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart. So you will find favor
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart In all your ways acknowledge him Don't be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh It will be health to your body
Honor Yahweh with your substance so your barns will be filled with plenty
My son for whom Yahweh loves

Happy is the man who finds wisdom For her good profit is better than getting silver She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her. Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor. Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace. She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her. By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding By his knowledge
My son so they will be life to your soul Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won't stumble. When you lie down Don't be afraid of sudden fear for Yahweh will be your confidence

Don't withhold good from those to whom it is due Don't say to your neighbor Don't devise evil against your neighbor Don't strive with a man without cause Don't envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways. For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh Yahweh's curse is in the house of the wicked Surely he mocks the mockers The wise will inherit glory

Listen for I give you sound learning. Don't forsake my law. For I was a son to my father He taught me Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget Don't forsake her Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes Esteem her She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.

Listen I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths. When you go Take firm hold of instruction. Don't let her go. Keep her Don't enter into the path of the wicked. Don't walk in the way of evil men. Avoid it For they don't sleep For they eat the bread of wickedness But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don't know what they stumble over.

My son Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart. For they are life to those who find them Keep your heart with all diligence Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you. Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established. Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

My son that you may maintain discretion For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil But in the end she is as bitter as wormwood Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol. She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked Now therefore Remove your way far from her. Don't come near the door of her house lest you give your honor to others lest strangers feast on your wealth You will groan at your latter end and say neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers I have come to the brink of utter ruin

Drink water out of your own cistern Should your springs overflow in the streets Let them be for yourself alone Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth. A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love. For why should you For the ways of man are before the eyes of Yahweh. He examines all his paths. The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly. He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly
My son You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth. Do this now Give no sleep to your eyes Free yourself
Go to the ant which having no chief provides her bread in the summer How long will you sleep A little sleep so your poverty will come as a robber

A worthless person who winks with his eyes in whose heart is perverseness Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes haughty eyes a heart that devises wicked schemes a false witness who utters lies

My son Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck. When you walk For the commandment is a lamp to keep you from the immoral woman Don't lust after her beauty in your heart For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life. Can a man scoop fire into his lap Or can one walk on hot coals So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished. Men don't despise a thief but if he is found He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul. He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away. For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won't spare in the day of vengeance. He won't regard any ransom

My son Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye. Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart. Tell wisdom that they may keep you from the strange woman For at the window of my house I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding passing through the street near her corner in the twilight Behold She is loud and defiant. Her feet don't stay in her house. Now she is in the streets So she caught him Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. This day I have paid my vows. Therefore I came out to meet you I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry I have perfumed my bed with myrrh Come For my husband isn't at home. He has gone on a long journey. He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon. With persuasive words He followed her immediately Until an arrow strikes through his liver Now therefore Don't let your heart turn to her ways. Don't go astray in her paths for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes Her house is the way to Sheol

Doesn't wisdom cry out? Doesn't understanding raise her voice? On the top of high places by the way Beside the gates To you men You simple Hear For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips. All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them. They are all plain to him who understands Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold. For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can't be compared to it. I The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power. By me kings reign By me princes rule; nobles I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me. With me are riches My fruit is better than gold I walk in the way of righteousness That I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work I was set up from everlasting When there were no depths Before the mountains were settled in place while as yet he had not made the earth When he established the heavens when he established the clouds above when he gave to the sea its boundary then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day Rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men. Now therefore Hear instruction Blessed is the man who hears me For whoever finds me But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.

Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars. She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table. She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city: Whoever is simple Come Leave your simple ways

He who corrects a mocker invites insult. He who reproves a wicked man invites abuse. Don't reprove a scoffer Instruct a wise man The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding. For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased. If you are wise

The foolish woman is loud She sits at the door of her house To call to those who pass by Whoever is simple Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant. But he doesn't know that the dead are there
There is one who scatters The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself. People curse someone who withholds grain
The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor He who despises his neighbor sins
Don't they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good. In all hard work there is profit
The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them. Train up a child in the way he should go
The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender. He who sows wickedness reaps trouble
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread The wicked desires the plunder of evil men
The soul of the sluggard desires A righteous man hates lies

Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth. Honest balances and scales are Yahweh's; all the weights in the bag are his work. It is an abomination for kings to do wrong Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
Treasures of wickedness profit nothing
Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry
He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand
He who gathers in summer is a wise son
Blessings are on the head of the righteous
The memory of the righteous is blessed
The wise in heart accept commandments
He who walks blamelessly walks surely
One winking with the eye causes sorrow
The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life
Hatred stirs up strife
Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment
Wise men lay up knowledge
The rich man's wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
He is in the way of life who heeds correction
He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many
Yahweh's blessing brings wealth
It is a fool's pleasure to do wickedness
What the wicked fear
When the whirlwind passes
As vinegar to the teeth
The fear of Yahweh prolongs days
The prospect of the righteous is joy
The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright
The righteous will never be removed
The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh
When pride comes
The integrity of the upright shall guide them
Riches don't profit in the day of wrath
The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them
When a wicked man dies
A righteous person is delivered out of trouble
With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor
When it goes well with the righteous
By the blessing of the upright
One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom
One who brings gossip betrays a confidence
Where there is no wise guidance
He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it
A gracious woman obtains honor
The merciful man does good to his own soul
Wicked people earn deceitful wages
He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh
Most certainly
Like a gold ring in a pig's snout
The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
He who diligently seeks good seeks favor
He who trusts in his riches will fall
He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
Behold
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge
A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh
A man shall not be established by wickedness
A worthy woman is the crown of her husband
The thoughts of the righteous are just
The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood
The wicked are overthrown
A man shall be commended according to his wisdom
Better is he who is lightly esteemed
A righteous man respects the life of his animal
An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man's hands shall be rewarded to him.
The way of a fool is right in his own eyes
A fool shows his annoyance the same day
He who is truthful testifies honestly
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword
Truth's lips will be established forever
Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil
No mischief shall happen to the righteous
Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh
A prudent man keeps his knowledge
The hands of the diligent ones shall rule
Anxiety in a man's heart weighs it down
A righteous person is cautious in friendship
The slothful man doesn't roast his game
In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
A wise son listens to his father's instruction
By the fruit of his lips
He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
Righteousness guards the way of integrity
There are some who pretend to be rich
The ransom of a man's life is his riches
The light of the righteous shines brightly
Pride only breeds quarrels
Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away
Hope deferred makes the heart sick
Whoever despises instruction will pay for it
The teaching of the wise is a spring of life
Good understanding wins favor; but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
Every prudent man acts from knowledge
A wicked messenger falls into trouble
Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline
Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul
One who walks with wise men grows wise
Misfortune pursues sinners
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children
An abundance of food is in poor people's fields
One who spares the rod hates his son
The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul
Every wise woman builds her house
He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh
The fool's talk brings a rod to his back
Where no oxen are
A truthful witness will not lie
A scoffer seeks wisdom
Stay away from a foolish man
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way
Fools mock at making atonement for sins
The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
The house of the wicked will be overthrown
There is a way which seems right to a man
Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
A simple man believes everything
A wise man fears
He who is quick to become angry will commit folly
The simple inherit folly
The evil bow down before the good
The crown of the wise is their riches
A truthful witness saves souls
In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress
The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life
In the multitude of people is the king's glory
He who is slow to anger has great understanding
The life of the body is a heart at peace
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker
The wicked is brought down in his calamity
Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding
Righteousness exalts a nation
A gentle answer turns away wrath
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge
Yahweh's eyes are everywhere
A gentle tongue is a tree of life
A fool despises his father's correction
In the house of the righteous is much treasure
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh
The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh
There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
A scoffer doesn't love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
A glad heart makes a cheerful face; but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge
All the days of the afflicted are wretched
Better is little
Better is a dinner of herbs
A wrathful man stirs up contention
The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch
A wise son makes a father glad
Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom
Where there is no counsel
Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
The path of life leads upward for the wise
Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud
Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked
He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house
The heart of the righteous weighs answers
Yahweh is far from the wicked
The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
The ear that listens to reproof lives
He who refuses correction despises his own soul
The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
The plans of the heart belong to man
All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh
Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes
Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
When a man's ways please Yahweh
Better is a little with righteousness
A man's heart plans his course
The king's wrath is a messenger of death
In the light of the king's face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
Pride goes before destruction
It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor
He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it
The heart of the wise instructs his mouth
Pleasant words are a honeycomb
There is a way which seems right to a man
The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
A man of violence entices his neighbor
One who winks his eyes to plot perversities
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit
The lot is cast into the lap
Better is a dry morsel with quietness
A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame
The refining pot is for silver
An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
Children's children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
Arrogant speech isn't fitting for a fool
A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns
He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man
Whoever rewards evil for good
The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam
He who justifies the wicked
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom
A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
A man void of understanding strikes hands
He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
One who has a perverse heart doesn't find prosperity
He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine
A wicked man receives a bribe in secret
Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding
A foolish son brings grief to his father
Also to punish the righteous is not good
He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
Even a fool
An unfriendly man pursues selfishness
A fool has no delight in understanding
When wickedness comes
The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good
A fool's lips come into strife
A fool's mouth is his destruction
The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person's innermost parts.
One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
The name of Yahweh is a strong tower: the righteous run to him
The rich man's wealth is his strong city
Before destruction the heart of man is proud
He who gives answer before he hears
A man's spirit will sustain him in sickness
The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
A man's gift makes room for him
He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
The lot settles disputes
A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city; and disputes are like the bars of a castle.
A man's stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing
The poor plead for mercy
A man of many companions may be ruined
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
It isn't good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one's feet and missing the way.
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
Wealth adds many friends
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
Many will entreat the favor of a ruler
All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas
He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool
The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
The king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion
A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife's quarrels are a continual dripping.
House and riches are an inheritance from fathers
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul
He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
Discipline your son
A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty
Listen to counsel and receive instruction
There are many plans in a man's heart
That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
The fear of Yahweh leads to life
The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
Flog a scoffer
He who robs his father and drives away his mother
If you stop listening to instruction
A corrupt witness mocks justice
Penalties are prepared for scoffers
Wine is a mocker
The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be quarreling.
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest
Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
Many men claim to be men of unfailing love
A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
Who can say
Differing weights and differing measures
Even a child makes himself known by his doings
The hearing ear
Don't love sleep
It's no good
There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Fraudulent food is sweet to a man
Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don't keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
Whoever curses his father or his mother
An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning
Don't say
Yahweh detests differing weights
A man's steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication
A wise king winnows out the wicked
The spirit of man is Yahweh's lamp
Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
Wounding blows cleanse away evil
The king's heart is in Yahweh's hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
Every way of a man is right in his own eyes
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
A high look
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
The violence of the wicked will drive them away
The way of the guilty is devious
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop
The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
When the mocker is punished
The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor
A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak
It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the dead.
He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous for the upright.
It is better to dwell in a desert land
There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life
A wise man scales the city of the mighty
Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
The proud and haughty man
The desire of the sluggard kills him
There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don't withhold.
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: how much more
A false witness will perish
A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
A good name is more desirable than great riches
The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
A prudent man sees danger
He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
Drive out the mocker
He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king's friend.
The eyes of Yahweh watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
The sluggard says
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit: he who is under Yahweh's wrath will fall into it.
Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich
Turn your ear
For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you
That your trust may be in Yahweh
Haven't I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge
To teach you truth
Don't exploit the poor
for Yahweh will plead their case
Don't befriend a hot-tempered man
lest you learn his ways
Don't you be one of those who strike hands
If you don't have means to pay
Don't move the ancient boundary stone
Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won't serve obscure men.
When you sit to eat with a ruler
put a knife to your throat
Don't be desirous of his dainties
Don't weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom
Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
Don't eat the food of him who has a stingy eye
for as he thinks about the cost
The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up
Don't speak in the ears of a fool
Don't move the ancient boundary stone. Don't encroach on the fields of the fatherless:
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
Apply your heart to instruction
Don't withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod
Punish him with the rod
My son
yes
Don't let your heart envy sinners; but rather fear Yahweh all the day long.
Indeed surely there is a future hope
Listen
Don't be among ones drinking too much wine
for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
Listen to your father who gave you life
Buy the truth

Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies. The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain. She does him good She seeks wool and flax She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar. She rises also while it is yet night She considers a field She arms her waist with strength She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn't go out by night. She lays her hands to the distaff She opens her arms to the poor; yes She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet. She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple. Her husband is respected in the gates She makes linen garments and sells them Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come. She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue. She looks well to the ways of her household Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her: Many women do noble things Charm is deceitful Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
